legacy_implied_expectations_NOT_REVALIDA.interpretation: The market price does not require an implausible bull case, but it does require long-duration double-digit revenue growth and a recovery from roughly 12% TTM FCF margin to 20%-24% despite unprecedented AI capital intensity and potential dilution.

current_findings: Search·Cloud·AI의 복수 이익원은 유지된다. 기존 Bull은 Base보다 할인율을 낮추고 영구성장률을 높여 비대칭을 증폭했다. 상방의 상당 부분이 자본비용 가정에서 생기므로 비대칭 점수를 6→5로 낮춘다.
TTM Capex 약 1,324.02억 달러 이후 FCF는 약 532.73억 달러다. 투자자산 평가이익, 우선주 전환과 자금조달을 영업 현금창출·희석과 구분해야 한다.
implied_expectations.current_model_limit: 미국 9% 허들을 기준으로 동일 자본비용 민감도를 제시하고 검색 단위수익, AI 이용률과 Capex 이후 FCF/주로 투자회수를 입증한다.

method_changes: All three cases use US 9% discount rate and 3% terminal company-FCF growth.
Unlisted investments excluded; inherited liquid financial assets are a proxy, not all proven excess cash.
No free negative dilution. Positive dilution continues in the terminal period.
Reported-FCF compensation/repurchase/interest-income bridge is incomplete; outputs are diagnostic, not actionable fair values.

bear.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

base.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

bull.note: Positive terminal dilution lowers per-share terminal growth; cash distributions and funded buybacks must still be reconciled before investment use.

bear.description: Search growth slows materially, AI capex remains structurally heavy, Cloud competes on price and FCF margin recovers only modestly.

base.description: Search monetization remains resilient, Cloud and AI sustain strong growth, and FCF margin normalizes after the infrastructure build without perfect execution.

bull.description: Alphabet's full-stack AI position drives Search expansion, Cloud leadership, high utilization and strong FCF conversion, while dilution remains contained.

drivers: Structural Search advertising erosion and loss of distribution advantages
Cloud price competition and underutilized AI capacity
FCF margin stuck near 12%-15% despite elevated depreciation and financing costs
permanent_loss_case.nature_of_loss: A long-duration failure to earn the cost of capital and irreversible opportunity cost, not a near-term bankruptcy case.

notes:
2026-09-05 재심사: 상위 scenarios와 legacy_implied_expectations는 복구·보존한 과거 추정치이며 승인된 현재 가치가 아니다. 최신 판단은 re-evaluation-2026-09-05.md, 통일 허들 진단은 implied_expectations.uniform_hurdle_diagnostic(해당 종목)을 참조. 보고 FCF와 owner-FCFE의 비용·희석 브리지는 미완성이다. 총점 보류 종목의 상위 기대차/비대칭 점수도 과거 스냅샷이다.
기존 모델 메모(과거): All scenario outputs are estimates, not facts. Ten-year annual DCF uses year-end cash-flow discounting. Net financial assets equal June 2026 cash and short-term marketable securities less June long-term debt and preferred liquidation value; the August 2026 $25 billion debt issue is discussed separately because a matching post-issue cash balance is unavailable. Non-marketable securities are recognized with scenario-specific haircuts. Current displayed P/E is distorted by large unrealized equity gains. GOOG and GOOGL have the same operating value, but the observed class price spread should be applied at trade time.
